theme.name: Market failure in cultural provision
theme.claim: Museums and galleries maintain objects and educate people about culture and local history, but because of the positive externalities of these activities they would be under-provided without government intervention.

text.line: Across the country, these institutions play an important role in society by maintaining important objects and educating people about different cultures or local history.
There is a well-established market failure in meeting these objectives as the positive externalities associated with them mean they would be under-provided without government intervention.
